decision_basis: The accountable maintainer explicitly approved the public option on 2026-08-27 for the exact inventory-bound Prompt 31 corpus. Acquisition, retention, attributed public release, and external publication are authorized subject to the CMS Agreement for Use, accurate and non-misleading presentation, source-date and specification warnings, preserved suppression and population boundaries, and no inference that the records represent net prices or total U.S. medicine utilisation.
